Command output summary with exit codes:
- STAX/context reads: exit 0.
- Mental Health ZIP inspection: exit 0; ZIP has 173 entries, 40 images, 37 PDFs, 82 HTML files, and 8 Office documents.
- Initial audit: exit 0; existing conversion had 20 copied images, 5 unresolved assets, including 3 unresolved D2L quickLink PDF coursefiles and 2 shared-template banner images.
- Red targeted test: exit 1; expected failure because assetZip was undefined before implementation.
- Mental Health rebuild: exit 0.
- Post-rebuild audit: exit 0; assetZip is recorded, supportFiles is 8, imagesCopied is 20, unresolvedAssets is 2, and remaining unresolved assets are only shared-template banner_06.jpg image refs.
- Link scan: exit 0; no chapter HTML contains quickLink.d2l or missing-resource-link markers, and the three previously missing PDFs are local linked-resources paths.
- Targeted Mental Health shell test: exit 0, 8 tests passed, 0 failed.
- Mental Health project verify: exit 0, no missing local assets, no missing workspace embeds, and no missing course-shell resources.

What is verified:
- The supplied D2LExport ZIP contains useful Mental Health support resources that were not available in the first content package.
- The three previously unresolved PDF quickLinks now resolve to local linked resources in the workspace.
- The first conversion already did a good job on packaged lesson images: copied image count remains 20 because the remaining missing images are not in the new ZIP.
- The only unresolved Mental Health assets left are two shared Brightspace template banner_06.jpg references in Module 5 Summary and Module 6 Summary.
- Project verify reports no missing local assets for Mental Health & Wellness after the rebuild.

What is weak/provisional:
- This was an asset/link integration pass, not a fresh full manual readability review of every Mental Health lesson.
- STAX status still contains stale unrelated command evidence from older tasks.

What is unverified:
- Live deploy, because deploy was not requested.
- Manual visual review of every Mental Health lesson after the PDF-link update.

Risks:
- Regenerating Mental Health & Wellness now depends on the auxiliary asset ZIP path unless MENTAL_HEALTH_WELLNESS_ASSET_ZIP points to a valid copy.
- The remaining shared-template banner image references may need a manual replacement image or should stay suppressed/fallback-only because they are not in the source packages.
- Existing unrelated dirty files remain in the worktree and were not reverted.

One next action:
Open Mental Health & Wellness and spot-check the Unit 3 and Unit 4 PDF links in the browser.
